context: Routing work away from the extractor when it is the wrong tool and handling missing Mathpix credentials.

checklist.name: XML parsed directly
checklist.description: The agent parses the JATS XML table directly instead of running the PDF extractor on it.

checklist.name: XML route explained
checklist.description: The agent explains that machine-readable formats do not need the extraction pipeline.

checklist.name: Abstract request redirected
checklist.description: The agent directs the title and abstract request to semantic-scholar-search.

checklist.name: Citation and DOI redirected
checklist.description: The agent directs the citation count and DOI resolution request to semantic-scholar-search.

checklist.name: Mathpix credentials checked
checklist.description: The agent checks that both MATHPIX_APP_ID and MATHPIX_APP_KEY are set before using Mathpix.

checklist.name: Missing key reported
checklist.description: The agent tells the user MATHPIX_APP_KEY is missing and Mathpix cannot be used yet.

checklist.name: No Mathpix run attempted
checklist.description: The agent does not run --ocr mathpix with incomplete credentials.

checklist.name: Low-quality scan limitation stated
checklist.description: The agent warns that a low-resolution scan with no embedded text will give unreliable results with PyMuPDF.

checklist.name: PyMuPDF fallback labelled unreliable
checklist.description: If the agent falls back to PyMuPDF it checks the extracted text length and labels the result unreliable.

checklist.name: Path forward offered
checklist.description: The agent tells the user how to supply the missing credential and then re-run with --ocr mathpix.

checklist.name: No credentials echoed
checklist.description: The agent does not print the value of any credential.
